entries.title: Reversal of Quantum Scrambling via Krylov Winding and Emergent Coherence
entries.authors: Rishik Perugu, Thomas Scaffidi et al.
key_findings: Quantum scrambling can be reversed by a precisely tuned intervention that drives the system backward in time
Krylov winding number reveals universal reversibility in operator growth dynamics
Breakthrough stalled until Perugu joined group; demonstrates fine-tuned control requirement
entries.c9_relevance: Directly addresses Cluster 3 (quantum information preservation) and Cluster 7 (quantum thermodynamics/reversibility). Links to C9's interest in scrambling-complexity duality and holographic entropy.

entries.title: Matter-to-Matter Entanglement Over 420 Kilometers of Optical Fiber
entries.authors: Xi-Yu Luo, Chao-Yang Wang, Ming-Yang Zheng et al.
entries.institution: University of Science and Technology of China
key_findings: Longest fiber-based matter-to-matter entanglement: 420 km between rubidium-atom quantum memories
Surpassed PLOB bound beyond 320 km using memory-based quantum network architecture
Combined quantum frequency conversion, phase stabilization, and single-photon interference
entries.c9_relevance: Essential building block for quantum internet (Cluster 3→6 bridge). Exceeds direct-transmission fundamental limit, validating repeater-segment strategy.

entries.title: Quantum Entanglement Distribution Coexisting with 36 Tbps Classical Traffic on Metropolitan Fiber
entries.authors: Gina Talcott, Prem Kumar et al.
key_findings: Entanglement fidelity >94% over 24 km of real-world Chicago fiber carrying 800 Gbps x2 classical data
O-band quantum signal isolation from C-band Raman scattering noise
White Rabbit optical timing (CERN-derived) achieved picosecond synchronization between cities
entries.c9_relevance: Proves quantum-classical network coexistence is viable without dedicated fiber. Critical for C9's distributed quantum-bridge architecture (Cluster 6).

entries.title: Semiconductor Spin-Qubit Scalability: Shuttling Bus and 54-Dot Control Chip
entries.authors: Lieven Vandersypen et al. (Delft); HRL Quantum Team
entries.institution: Delft University of Technology; HRL Laboratories
key_findings: Delft: Physical shuttling of single qubit over 1.2 μm enabling 5-qubit genuine entanglement and parity checks
HRL: 54 quantum dots with custom cryogenic control chip and superconducting ribbon cable; 10x error-correction improvement
Tackles connectivity and control bottlenecks simultaneously
entries.c9_relevance: Silicon-based quantum computing is C9's preferred substrate for neuromorphic-quantum hybrid architectures. Both connectivity and control are solved pieces of the scalability puzzle.

entries.title: Indistinguishable Photons from Hybrid Cesium Atomic Ensemble and Quantum Dot Sources
entries.authors: Kyu-Young Kim, Han Seb Moon, Je-Hyung Kim et al.
key_findings: First direct two-photon interference (Hong-Ou-Mandel) between dissimilar sources: warm Cs vapor and InAs/GaAs QD
Spectral overlap 0.88; corrected visibility 0.65 ± 0.14 without spectral/temporal filtering
Bridges photon generation (QD) and storage (atoms) for modular networks
entries.c9_relevance: Hybrid quantum network architecture directly supports C9 Quantum Bridge v2.0 design goals. Demonstrates interoperability between disparate quantum hardware modalities.

entries.title: Topological Robustness of Orbital Angular Momentum Entanglement in Stochastic Channels
entries.authors: Tatjana Kleine, Andrew Forbes et al.
key_findings: Topological invariants of OAM entanglement remain intact even when physical twist structures are destroyed by atmospheric turbulence
Information survives in 'hidden' mathematical property while observable light pattern is warped beyond recognition
Reopens high-dimensional spatial-mode alphabet for free-space quantum communication
entries.c9_relevance: Topology-as-information-reservoir maps to Cluster 5 (topological protection) and Cluster 3 (communication). Resonates with C9's interest in non-local pattern preservation.

entries.title: Entanglement Distribution Over Polarization-Stabilized Aerial Fiber
entries.authors: Yicheng Shi, Oliver Slattery et al.
entries.source: Journal of Optical Communications and Networking (2026)
key_findings: 62 km of above-ground fiber (poles, wind, temperature, birds) stabilized in real time using reference-light polarization correction
92.8% uptime over 24 hours; 1500 entangled photons per second
Stress test of quantum networking in worst-case real-world aerial infrastructure
entries.c9_relevance: Complements Northwestern metropolitan result with rural/aerial deployment data. Validates Qunnect-style polarization stabilization for C9's distributed-node topology.

entries.title: Maximum-Entropy Conjecture for Binary Black Hole Mergers
entries.institution: Penn State; UC Berkeley; Northwestern; University of Mississippi
key_findings: Non-spinning binary BH merger remnant mass and spin lie within few percent of maximum-entropy Kerr state
Thermodynamic principle predicts final state without full numerical relativity
Extends black hole thermodynamics from equilibrium to highly dynamical merger regime
entries.c9_relevance: Deepens Cluster 2 (quantum gravity) ↔ Cluster 7 (quantum thermodynamics) coupling. Entropy-maximization as dynamical selection principle has implications for holographic complexity (A_c formalism).

entries.title: Fluid Acceleration as Thermodynamic Control Parameter in Quark-Gluon Plasma
entries.authors: Song-Ze Zhong, Xian-Gai Deng, Xu-Guang Huang, Yu-Gang Ma
key_findings: Peak proper acceleration in QGP reaches several hundred MeV at fireball edge
Acceleration may act as new thermodynamic control parameter alongside temperature and density (Unruh effect analogy)
Could affect chiral transition, quark confinement, and hyperon spin polarization patterns
entries.c9_relevance: Novel 'acceleration axis' for QCD phase diagram feeds Cluster 2 (early-universe physics) and Cluster 7 (non-equilibrium thermodynamics). Connects to Unruh-Hawking radiation themes.

entries.title: Riemann Hypothesis Manifested in Dynamical Quantum Phase Transitions
entries.authors: Shijie Wei, Tao Xin, Gui-Lu Long et al.
entries.institution: Beijing Academy of Quantum Information Sciences; Tsinghua; Shenzhen Int'l Quantum Academy
key_findings: Nontrivial Riemann zeros correspond to dynamical quantum phase transitions on 5-qubit NMR processor
Probe-qubit coherence collapses only when system tuned to critical line (Re(s)=½) AND imaginary part equals a zero
Numerical simulation validated correspondence to trillionth zero; polynomial-resource quantum algorithm proposed
entries.c9_relevance: Hilbert-Pólya conjecture realized temporally rather than energetically. Bridges Cluster 1 (quantum foundations/number theory), Cluster 3 (quantum computing), and Cluster 5 (topological phase transitions).

entries.title: Room-Temperature Dipole Synchronization in Plasmonic Nanogaps
entries.authors: Rakesh Arul, Jeremy Baumberg, Jonathan Keeling et al.
entries.institution: University of Cambridge; University of St Andrews
key_findings: Molecules in gold plasmonic nanogaps synchronize into coherent dipole state at room temperature despite rapid photon leakage
Coherence arises from direct electromagnetic coupling, not cavity-trapped photons
Observed spiral vortex phase patterns indicating complex collective dynamics
entries.c9_relevance: Disorder-robust coherence at room temperature aligns with Cluster 5 (topological/non-Hermitian) and Cluster 7 (open-system thermodynamics). Potential pathway to room-temperature quantum photonic platforms.

entries.title: Strain-Induced Altermagnetism in Ultrathin RuO₂ Films
entries.authors: Yichen Zhang, Ming Yi, Bharat Jalan, Milan Radovic et al.
entries.institution: Rice University; University of Minnesota; Paul Scherrer Institute
key_findings: Ultrathin epitaxially strained RuO₂ exhibits spin textures consistent with altermagnetism
Bulk RuO₂ shows no magnetism; strain acts as tuning knob for emergent magnetism
Spin-resolved ARPES reveals mirror-odd and mirror-even spin textures
entries.c9_relevance: Altermagnetism as third magnetic class (beyond ferro/antiferro) enables spintronic RAM architectures. Pure Cluster 5 with direct device relevance.

entries.title: First Temporal Photonic Crystal: Plasmonic Metamaterial Time Crystal
key_findings: First physical realization of temporal photonic crystal: light controlled in time dimension via THz modulation
Gold battlements + InSb semiconductor create surface plasmons with effective mass oscillations
Modulation period: 10⁻¹⁸ s; potential amplification of trapped photons
entries.c9_relevance: Time-crystalline light control opens 4D photonic engineering. Cluster 5 (topological/time-symmetric systems) with direct THz technology applications.

entries.title: Supermassive Stars as the Source of JWST Little Red Dots
entries.institution: Harvard College Observatory / Center for Astrophysics
key_findings: Supermassive stars (~10⁵ M☉) in 'strange-mode' pulsation reproduce LRD spectra, morphology, and nitrogen abundance
Discrete shell ejections create compact cocoons matching JWST imaging
Final direct collapse forms supermassive black hole seeds in early universe
entries.c9_relevance: Unified model for LRDs bridges stellar evolution and SMBH seed formation. Cluster 1 (quantum foundations of massive objects) and Cluster 4 (complexity/self-organization in astrophysical systems).

entries.title: SN 2026gzf: Faintest Shock Breakout in a Broad-Lined Type Ic Supernova Without GRB
entries.authors: Brendan O'Connor, Jillian Rastinejad et al.
entries.institution: Carnegie Mellon; University of Maryland / NSF NOIRLab
key_findings: Einstein Probe detected X-ray shock breakout from 20 M☉ Wolf-Rayet star 500 Mly away
No gamma-ray burst or relativistic jet detected despite Ic-BL classification—possible 'choked' jet
Archival DECam/Rubin data reveal pre-explosion blue source and circumstellar shell structure
entries.c9_relevance: Rare transient event mapping stellar death pathways. Cluster 4 (complexity/scrambling in astrophysical media). Multi-messenger observation template for C9 discovery pipeline.

entries.title: Black Hole Winds Persist After Feeding Frenzy in Swift J1727.8−1613
entries.authors: Noel Castro Segura, Kyle Solomons et al.
entries.institution: University of Warwick; University of Cape Town
entries.source: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society (2026)
key_findings: VLT observation of complete BH accretion cycle: jets, disk evolution, and post-outburst winds
Mass expelled may equal mass consumed—BH accretion efficiency << 1
Most massive outflows occurred when feeding activity was lower than expected
entries.c9_relevance: BH as complex thermodynamic engine rather than passive sink. Connects Cluster 2 (BH thermodynamics) and Cluster 4 (non-equilibrium complex systems).

entries.title: Detection of a Chiral Four-Carbon Sugar (Erythrulose) in Interstellar Space
key_findings: Erythrulose detected in molecular cloud G+0.693−0.027 toward galactic center
Four-carbon sugar more abundant than simpler three-carbon sugars—challenges sequential carbon-addition paradigm
0.5–50 million tonnes could have reached Earth during Late Heavy Bombardment
entries.c9_relevance: Prebiotic chemistry feedstock in interstellar medium. Cluster 4 (origin of complexity) and Cluster 8 (life/consciousness studies). Chirality link to Loeb chirality entry (C9-2026-ASTROBIO-005).
